activity.notes: Tugorkan is the Cuman/Polovtsian leader called Togortak in the Alexiad. He is documented in the 1091 Byzantine alliance, the 1094 peace and marriage alliance with Sviatopolk, and was killed in the fighting near Pereiaslav in 1096. This is an attested leadership floruit, not a claim that he first became khan in 1091 or ruled every Kipchak group.
